core_obligations: Ample canonical sheaf (proof lines 6506-6510): contract rational bridges along X = X_0 -> X_1 -> ... -> X_n = X' until none are left; then omega_{X'} is ample by lemma-no-rational-bridge-ample-genus-geq-2.

Canonicity of the contraction (lines 6512-6524): by lemma-rational-bridge-canonical and induction f^*omega_{X'} = omega_X; f_*O_X = O_{X'} because each single contraction of a rational bridge has this property; the projection formula then gives f_*f^*L = L for every invertible O_{X'}-module L, whence Gamma(X', omega_{X'}^{\otimes m}) = Gamma(X, omega_X^{\otimes m}) for all m; since X' is the Proj of the direct sum of these (morphisms-lemma-proper-ample-is-proj), the morphism X -> X' is completely canonical, i.e. independent of the choices made.

Base field extensions (lines 6526-6537): for K/k a field extension, omega_{X_K} is the pullback of omega_X (lemma-sanity-check-duality) and Gamma(X, omega_X^{\otimes m}) \otimes_k K = Gamma(X_K, omega_{X_K}^{\otimes m}) by flat base change (coherent-lemma-flat-base-change-cohomology); thus formation of f : X -> X' commutes with base change by the arguments given above; the author closes with 'Some details omitted.' (recorded verbatim; see notes).
proof_roadmap: Contract rational bridges until none remain and get omega_{X'} ample.
Prove f^*omega_{X'} = omega_X and f_*O_X = O_{X'}, then use the projection formula and the Proj description for canonicity.
Transport the construction along a base field extension via pullback of the dualizing module and cohomology base change.

H3: multi-step canonicity argument.
